Looking for a safe healthy natural way to relax without alcohol prescriptions or illegal drugs
205lb male tolerant to alcohol, caffeine and nicotine.  No experience ever with pot, illegal drugs or prescription pain killers/anxiolytics.  Purchased an assortment of remedies from a very popular online shop.  No effect from earlier trials.  Was I sent placebos? I_am_certain Ill not order from this shop again. Earlier this week tried 2mg kraton 10:1 / 10x extract in juice after eating without effect.  Next day after eating tried 4mg in juice followed by a beer then 1/4oz 84% kavalactone paste then another beer then tried to smoke 1g three lotus paste with diviners three burning blend (hurt my lungs) so I just ate the resin instead and decided to smoke a cigar.  This had no effect other then that attributed to the beers.
0800 weightlifted
1200 sushi lunch
1400 using a kitchen scale tried to measure out 8g 10x standardized extract powder from my 2 12g bags.  Mixed in water with crystal lite and drank fast (brown and a little bitter). Realized I goofed and took a ½ oz about 14g  most of my 24gm is now gone.
1415 My Jaw gets tight
1430 Online looking up dosages and complications for too much Kratom.  A youtube comment states that some of the extracts arent much stronger than pure leaf (ohh this must be my stuff).
1435 sore muscle pains from weight training go away.  I feel like I had a hot bath and a massage.  My jaw is ok.  Interesting.  Maybe this stuff is for real.
1450 notice that Im walking a little slow and careful ... like when I drink a bottle of wine (or more)
1510 Go to the garage, sit in front of a heat lamp and smoke a cigar.  Watch a movie on my laptop 'The 300'
1600 The movie is great and the cigar is smoking perfectly.  I feel like a cat lounging in a sunny spot on the carpet.  This is
exactly where I want to be with my experience.  Wow, this stuff is real!
1625 Begin to sweet.  The cigar seems too strong and too much for me.  I feel green like I've never smoked a strong cigar before (Ive smoked for 10yrs)
1630 The movies over.  Dont like how I feel
1632 Go upstairs, put my headphones on and turn down the lights.  Not sure if Im going to get nauseated or not.  I hope I dont get dizzy like if I drank 2 bottles of wine.  Need to pee.  try not to move(worried about provoking nausea)
1645 my body is very relaxed.  I dont want to move or think.  Dont need to pee anymore(hmmm)  I have no appetite even though I'm on a diet and eat frequently. I should be hungry and if I was this drunk I would have gorged myself by now.
1700 the music is ok.  Drift in and out of sleep I guess.  No interesting dreams or hallucinations.
1830 Feel better, some appetite, go down for a soda.  Eat a very light dinner and have a snack latter while watching TV
sleep well, no hang over next day.  If I drank myself to where I was last night I would have been very hungover.  Ill try 10g next time.
